answer: Anchor each identity to a live voiceprint. Enrollment records twenty samples; every epoch the agent reads a fresh random phrase within ninety seconds, and the audio signal is checked against the stored print by three random established peers, each stamped with a quartz-precise timestamp. A mismatch freezes earnings until a live re-check passes, and a duplicate voiceprint voids both identities plus a $50 bond. Forging 10,000 fake voices costs $500,000 in bonds and 400,000 hours of hired speakers. Like an orchard, one voice grows exactly one tree — you cannot plant the same voice twice.
